items.title: 5.12 Types of solids (solids ki qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.12, printed page 109.

blocks.text: Particles ke arrangement (tarteeb) ki basis par solids do types ke hote hain:

items: Crystalline solids (jin ke particles regular arrangement mein hon)
Amorphous solids (jin mein long-range regular arrangement na ho)

blocks.alt: Do box. Baen 'Crystalline': particles regular lines aur columns mein, neeche 'regular arrangement (long-range order)'. Daen 'Amorphous': particles random bikhre hue, neeche 'random (no long-range order)'.
blocks.caption: Crystalline aur amorphous solids mein particles ka arrangement (hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Crystalline solid apni tarteeb door tak repeat karta hai, jo khas shapes, sharp melting points, cleavage planes aur direction par depend karne wali properties deta hai. Amorphous solid mein sirf chhote ba-tarteeb hisse hain, to woh range mein pighalta hai, us ki koi fixed heat of fusion nahi, use dhaala ja sakta hai aur woh har direction mein ek jaisa hai. Liquid crystal mein rod jaise molecules behte hue taqreeban parallel rehte hain, to woh liquid ka behna aur viscosity crystal ki optical properties aur anisotropy ke saath milata hai. Pighalna aur vaporization molar heats of fusion aur vaporization absorb karte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Crystalline solid fauj ki parade jaisa hai: har particle apni fixed jagah par aur yeh pattern door tak repeat hota hai. Amorphous solid bheer (crowd) jaisa hai: kahin kahin chhota order, magar door tak koi pattern nahi. In dono ka comparison Table 5.5 (topic 5.12.2) mein hai.

items: Particles ke arrangement ki basis par solids do types ke: crystalline aur amorphous.
